publisher: Maine GeoLibrary / MCHT Combined Parcels (Piscataquis rows)
notes: Combined municipal and MRS parcels; PI-prefixed county codes denote Piscataquis. Parcels over 1,000 ha (whole-township unorganized-territory lots whose polygons extend far beyond their reference point) are excluded. Owner and address fields are empty in this source; apn is map_bk_lot (town lot id).
